hook.say: The ten highest volcanoes on Earth, ranked. All in one mountain range!

outro.say: Heard of any of them? Comment below!

items.name: Sajama
items.say: Number ten: Sahahma, the highest peak in Bolivia. 6550 meters.
items.cap: Number ten: Sajama, the highest peak in Bolivia. 6,550 meters.

items.name: Tupungato
items.say: Nine: Tupungato, a giant near Santiago. 6570 meters.
items.cap: Nine: Tupungato, a giant near Santiago. 6,570 meters.

items.name: Incahuasi
items.say: Eight: Inkawahsee, the house of the Inca. 6621 meters.
items.cap: Eight: Incahuasi, the house of the Inca. 6,621 meters.

items.name: Tres Cruces Central
items.say: Seven: Tress Crooses Central, one of three crosses. 6629 meters.
items.cap: Seven: Tres Cruces Central, one of three crosses. 6,629 meters.

items.name: Cazadero
items.say: Six: Cazadero, also called Valter Penck. 6670 meters.
items.cap: Six: Cazadero, also called Walther Penck. 6,670 meters.

items.name: Tres Cruces Sur
items.say: Five: Tress Crooses South, tallest of the three. 6748 meters.
items.cap: Five: Tres Cruces Sur, tallest of the three. 6,748 meters.

items.name: Llullaillaco
items.say: Four: Yooyai-yahko, the last one seen erupting. 6752 meters.
items.cap: Four: Llullaillaco, the last one seen erupting. 6,752 meters.

items.name: Cerro Bonete
items.say: Three: Serro Bonaytay, hidden in Argentina's desert. 6759 meters.
items.cap: Three: Cerro Bonete, hidden in Argentina's desert. 6,759 meters.

items.name: Monte Pissis
items.say: Two: Montay Peeseess, third highest in the Americas. 6793 meters.
items.cap: Two: Monte Pissis, third highest in the Americas. 6,793 meters.

items.name: Ojos del Salado
items.say: And number one: Ohos del Salado, Earth's highest volcano! 6893 meters.
items.cap: And number one: Ojos del Salado, Earth's highest volcano! 6,893 meters.
